**BOHJ18A4 - Behandling med golimumab** is a clinical code utilized within the Danish Inflammatory Bowel Disease Database (DANIBD) to register treatments involving golimumab, an anti-TNF biologic medication [^src1]. 

According to the 2023 DANIBD annual report, which covers quality data from October 1, 2022, to September 30, 2023, this specific code is applied exclusively to adult patients [^src1]. During this reporting period, golimumab treatments registered under BOHJ18A4 constituted only a minor proportion of the total therapies categorized under [[bmsl|Biologiske og målrettede syntetiske lægemidler]] (biological and targeted synthetic drugs) [^src1]. The inclusion of this code in the registry's appendix tables supports the broader national effort to systematize IBD treatment in Denmark, enabling standardized coding, clinical benchmarking, and the evaluation of patient access to advanced biologic therapies across regions.
